title: 歡迎你來臺灣！ Welcome to Taiwan!
statusDetail: Materi ini ditulis ulang secara orisinal untuk situs ini berdasarkan topik dan kosakata Pelajaran 1 buku ajar (hlm. buku 1–8): soal latihan, kalimat contoh, dan kunci memakai kata-kata sendiri. Soal bergambar asli ada di buku; audio trek asli tetap ditautkan.
transcribedBy: Ditulis ulang secara orisinal berdasarkan isi buku, diperiksa terhadap halaman asli, 2026-11-18

paras.text: Topic: 歡迎與自我介紹 Greetings and Self-Introduction
• Practicing tone recognition for Lesson 1 vocabulary.
• Practicing listening comprehension about greetings, nationality and likes/dislikes.
• Practicing the A-not-A question pattern, word order, and writing characters from pinyin.
Practice exercise written for this site using Lesson 1 vocabulary. The book's own tone-marking exercise is on book p. 1; its recording is track 01-01.

blocks.en: II. Listen and Respond: Nice to Meet You
blocks.zh: 二、請聽並回答：很高興認識你

paras.text: Practice exercise written for this site using Lesson 1 vocabulary. The book's own listening exercises are on book pp. 1–2; their recordings are tracks 01-02, 01-03 and 01-04.
A. Listen to what is said about Miss Chen and choose the correct answer to each question below. (track 01-02)

blocks.title: A. 陳小姐
blocks.instruction: Choose the correct answer for each question.

items.prompt: 陳小姐喜歡喝什麼？ a. 茶　b. 咖啡
陳小姐是不是日本人？ a. 是　b. 不是
陳小姐喜不喜歡喝烏龍茶？ a. 喜歡　b. 不喜歡

paras.text: B. I would like to know more about Mr. Wu and Miss Lin. Write the appropriate letters in the parentheses below. (a. 吳先生　b. 林小姐　c. 臺灣人　d. 美國人 — track 01-03)

blocks.title: B. 吳先生、林小姐
blocks.instruction: Write the appropriate letter in each blank.

paras.text: C. Listen to the dialogue. Write ○ if the statement is true, × if it is false. (track 01-04)

blocks.title: A. 句子配對
blocks.instruction: Match the sentence on the left with the appropriate reply on the right; write the matching letter in each blank.

items.prompt: （　）你是不是美國人？　　　(A) 謝謝你。

paras.text: B. Complete the greetings and replies based on the information provided: a. 你好！　b. 謝謝你。　c. 不客氣。　d. 我是臺灣人。

blocks.title: B. 完成對話
blocks.instruction: Fill in the blank with the matching reply.

paras.text: A. Introduce yourself and your friends. Read the paragraph and answer the questions below.
我姓林，叫開文。我是臺灣人。我很喜歡喝烏龍茶。臺灣烏龍茶很好喝。他姓王，叫大同。他是美國人，他很喜歡喝咖啡。美國咖啡很好喝。我們喜歡臺灣。
B. Look at the name card below and complete the dialogue.
國立臺灣師範大學國語教學中心　王開文　主編　10610臺北市和平東路一段129號
a. 王　b. 主編　c. 開文　d. 王開文

blocks.title: B. 名片問答
blocks.instruction: Complete each answer using the name card above.

paras.text: Write out each question using the "A-not-A" pattern and give a negative answer.

blocks.en: VI. Rearrange the Characters Below to Make Good Sentences

blocks.title: 練習 Exercise
blocks.instruction: Rearrange the given characters into a correct sentence.

items.prompt: 美國人　不是　你　是　請問　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿？
很　好喝　普洱茶　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿。
喝　喜歡　很　咖啡　我　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿。
是　林小姐　嗎　臺灣人　不　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿？
你　臺灣　來　歡迎　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿。

blocks.en: VII. Write Out in Chinese Characters

paras.text: Practice exercise written for this site using Lesson 1 vocabulary. The book's own dictation exercise is on book p. 6; its recording is track 01-05.

blocks.title: 練習 Exercise
blocks.instruction: Listen to the recording and write out the sentences below in Chinese characters.

items.prompt: Qǐngwèn nǐ shì Lín Xiǎojiě ma?　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿？
Wǒ xǐhuān hē wūlóngchá, nǐ ne?　→ ＿＿＿＿＿＿？

paras.text: Complete the sentences below to introduce yourself.

blocks.title: 練習 Exercise
blocks.instruction: Fill in each blank to write your own self-introduction.

items.prompt: 我是＿＿＿＿＿＿人。我喜歡喝＿＿＿＿＿＿，不喜歡喝＿＿＿＿＿＿。我很高興認識你們。
